gen-luckiest-guy-gf-mozilla-text: Luckiest Guy hollers in poured, uniform ink and a high, mean line. Mozilla Text goes the other way, a sans with tall lowercase bodies and flared terminals that make ordinary words look sturdy.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-nata-sans: Cheerful and loud, Luckiest Guy sets heavy, poured-looking letters with an e that opens to the right. Nata Sans takes over with wide-mouthed curves and a technical-pen steadiness that feels quiet by comparison.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-nobile: Luckiest Guy sits high and mean, every stroke poured at one thickness. Nobile pulls the other way, its capitals barely taller than its lowercase and its open mouths like chalk arcs left unjoined, so the two fit snugly.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-nokora: Nokora reads wide and friendly, its s never tightening up. Luckiest Guy brings the loud, dowel-straight cheer on top, and that thick, dark body stripe underneath is what lets it hold its own.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Cheerful describes the top line, where Luckiest Guy pours out glyphs that look drawn with a single tip. Noto Kufi Arabic follows with open-gapped c shapes and capitals barely above lowercase, so lines of text glide along without any fuss.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans: Loud, poured, unmistakable. Luckiest Guy keeps one line width throughout, and Noto Sans, a plain sans with lowercase filling most of the height, would likely drown it out if the heading were made small.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart and lets its lowercase stand tall and full. Luckiest Guy, with diagonals as heavy as its uprights, shouts above it, while Noto Sans Adlam keeps long text easy going.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjo: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined leaves generous gaps between its curve ends and stems, with hardly any height difference between cases. Luckiest Guy's cheerful, high-set loudness meets that restraint, and the gap between them is the pair's best quality.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Cheerful from the first glance, Luckiest Guy lays down horizontals as heavy as its verticals and an e that opens right. Noto Sans Arabic gives its small letters wide openings and a pronounced x-height, and that loud-meets-modern gap is the pair's strength.
gen-luckiest-guy-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Every curve in Luckiest Guy is as thick as a straight stem, as if the ink had been poured in one go. Noto Sans Armenian gives the quieter lowercase, tall and inviting, to do the actual reading.
